scope: Finite algebraic consequences of supplied Griess structure constants and multiplicity-space actions. Does not recompute lattice VOA modes or the full commutant kernel. Exported from original first implementation R3.

state_convention.doubled_lattice_vector: 16 integers y; actual vector is y/2 in E8 plus E8
state_convention.oscillator_monomial: list of [n,i] pairs representing eps_i(-n), indices 0 through 15
state_convention.basis_order: basis_G[j] is g_j, with j from 0 to 15; u=sum_j x_j*g_j
state_convention.cocycle: epsilon(a,b)=(-1)^(c(a)^T U c(b)) in each E8; simple roots and U are below

tensor_convention.actions: actions[g][i][j] = row i, column j of (g_g)_(1) on the indicated highest-weight multiplicity space

affine_coordinates.definition: x=c+N*t, in the order g_0,...,g_15 and t_0,...,t_7
